basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old music enthusiast from Lansing, Michigan, currently working as a high school music teacher. I've been deeply interested in folk and metal music since college, which I pursued at Michigan State University where I majored in Music Education. My evenings are often spent exploring new guitar techniques and soundscapes. I'm single and live with my cat named Fretty. I typically browse Reddit in the late evenings after dinner, around 8 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a formal education in music and have been teaching myself guitar through online resources and community feedback. My interest in audio equipment comes from trying to enhance my music sessions and teaching. I often read up on new technologies and trends in the musical instrument space.
